request: I want to do an FTP test to calibrate my power zones. Walk me through it
plan:
FTP TEST PROTOCOL — 20 min all-out effort

1. Warm-up (25 min)
   – 10 min easy Z2 spin
   – 3×1 min at FTP effort with 1 min rest
   – 5 min easy, then 5 min rest

2. FTP Test: 20 min MAX effort (start the timer)
   – Go as hard as you can sustain for the full 20 min
   – First 5 min: resist going too hard — common mistake
   – Mid-test (min 10): check and adjust. If fading: slightly reduce effort
   – Last 2 min: give everything remaining
   – Record average power for the 20 min

3. Cool-down (15 min easy Z1 spin)

Calculate FTP: average power × 0.95 = your FTP
   Example: 285W avg × 0.95 = 271W FTP

Do not train again today. Rest or easy walk tomorrow.
